question: Test whether bulk incidence or a fixed boundary Hodge star supplies the required odd-port cut and trigger.
assumptions: Mean-zero edge carrier, regular unit cell, equal face weights and fixed incidence.
Single scalar linear bulk mediation for the rank bound.
The uniform boundary Hodge comparison identifies primal faces and dual vertices by relabeling.
target_exposure: First directed half-stock hold target established in C06 v0.16–v0.17
fitted_choices: Equal-weight regular boundary comparison and shared actuation candidate; no empirical fit

sources.section_or_object_id: Whitney Hodge energy and cycle correction

baseline: C06 v0.23 face projector and Whitney port
result: A single scalar bulk channel has rank at most one, and its common-face pullback vanishes on mean-zero edges. The face complement realizes the projector. A fixed metric and incidence leave the switch underdetermined.
next_discriminant: Test an explicit state-dependent cell law with three independent face channels and one event authority.
